svg.text: System overview · request path, data model and lifecycles on one page
Guards: session → role, then ride ownership in the service. Public: /health, /zones, /auth/signup, /auth/login. A lower layer never imports an upper one.
seat change = lock vehicle → check → write
database rules hold even if code is wrong
PK primary · FK foreign · UQ unique
a completed ride stays JOINED; its pool is no longer active
Driver cancels before the start: riders go MATCHED / DRIVER_ARRIVED → REQUESTED, the pool → CANCELLED. Passenger cancels before the start; last one out closes the pool.
Joins (M1–M4): same pickup zone, pool still MATCHED, seats free, every detour ≤ 2 km. Any other transition is rejected (409); every ride status change writes a ride_event.
